title: Equivalence of the normalized four-term BKP addition identity with the formal BKP residue hierarchy on a domain where tau and the displayed shifted denominators are invertible
author: Yoko Shigyo
work: On Addition Formulae of KP, mKP and BKP Hierarchies
source_version: Official SIGMA 9 (2013) article 035, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2013.035; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-10-01, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The proof builds all odd and even multipoint tau ratios from the four-term relation through an inductive Pfaffian construction and a Pfaffian Sylvester identity. Pfaffian Plucker relations recover the complete addition system, and the weighted power-sum specialization argument then recovers every coefficient of the formal residue hierarchy.

original_metadata.statement_scope: Full Theorem3 in its normalized rational/formal setting: identity32 for arbitrary admissible Miwa parameters is equivalent to residue hierarchy28 in odd times. The residue is the explicit coefficient-extraction operator, not an analytic contour theorem; no extension across tau zeros is asserted.
